name: Can I use chemical drain cleaner for a clogged kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: Can I use chemical drain cleaner for a clogged kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: We generally advise against using chemical drain cleaners for clogged kitchen sinks. While they may seem like a quick fix, these products contain harsh chemicals that can corrode pipes, especially older ones, leading to costly leaks or damage over time. They are also often ineffective against severe clogs and can create dangerous fumes. If chemical cleaners don't clear the clog, they leave behind toxic standing water that can be hazardous for plumbers to work with. It's safer and more effective to use mechanical methods or call a professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, chemical drain cleaners can damage pipes, are often ineffective, and can create hazardous conditions for plumbers.
